events.title: Lake Walk Community Yoga
events.description:
Join the Lake Walk Community Yoga team every Saturday morning for an outdoor community yoga session at Lake Walk!

Held on our Pavilion lawn, this class is designed for yogis of all levels and serves as a weekly stretch session to open up your body and mind. Community Yoga is free to attend and open to the public.

Follow us on Facebook and Instagram @lakewalktx for class updates.

Please bring your own yoga mat and bottle of water. Class is held every Saturday, weather permitting. If temperatures are below 45º Fahrenheit, the class will be canceled. We will keep everyone updated on social media!
